nodes.label: GET /pr/dashboard-admin-qcf - Dashboard Admin QCF
nodes.rationale: Admin QCF dashboard. Carries no operationId and an empty description, unlike the hand-documented CS/CL operations - suggesting it was generated or imported rather than authored. Exposes the full nine-parameter filter set: page, limit, status_filter, action_filter, sort, order, search, date_from, date_to, all typed as string. Bearer secured.
